feedback.title: Add tags for feedback
feedback.description: Easier to search for posts based on a specific theme.

feedback.title: Add a dark theme option
feedback.description: It would help people with light sensitivities and who prefer dark mode.

feedback.title: Q&A within each product board
feedback.description: Board-specific Q&A would make for easy reference.

feedback.title: Add image/video upload to feedback
feedback.description: Images and screencasts can enhance comments on posts.

feedback.title: Ability to follow others
feedback.description: Stay updated on comments and posts other people make.

feedback.title: Preview images not loading
feedback.description: Board preview images are missing when you apply a filter.

feedback.title: More comprehensive reports
feedback.description: It would be great to see a more detailed breakdown of votes.

feedback.title: Weekly digest emails
feedback.description: A recap of new posts and status changes, sent every Monday.

feedback.title: One-click roadmap sharing
feedback.description: Add the ability to publish a read-only roadmap from a board.

feedback.title: Bookmark feedback
feedback.description: Be able to bookmark posts and return to them later on.

feedback.title: Animated avatars not rendering
feedback.description: Avatars with animation don't display correctly inside replies.

feedback.title: Add micro-interactions
feedback.description: Small animations at specific points can add delight.

comments.content: Awesome idea! Trying to find posts about one specific area inside a busy board can be tedious
Please use fun, color-coded labels to easily identify them at a glance

Also, please allow styles to be applied based on system preferences. I would love to be able to browse Townhall in the evening after my device's dark mode turns on without the bright background it currently has.

Second this! I do a lot of late night reading and triage. Adding a dark theme can be great for preventing eye strain and the headaches that result. It's also quite a trend with modern apps and apparently saves battery life.
Much easier to get answers from people who can relate, since they've either shipped the same thing themselves or are in the middle of it.
Right now, there is no ability to add images while giving feedback which isn't ideal because I have to use another app to show what I mean
Yes I'd like to see this as well. Sometimes I want to add a short video or gif to explain the site's behavior..
I also want to be notified when people I follow post something new here. Is in-app notification also in the pipeline?
I've been saving the profile URLs of a few people and I check what they've been doing from time to time. Being able to follow them solves that
This would be awesome! It would be so helpful to see an overview of my board in a way that makes it easy to spot where things could be improved.
Yeah, this would be really good. I'd love to see deeper insights into what people actually vote for!
Having a weekly summary land in my inbox would be brilliant! Sometimes I'm not sure which posts moved while I was away. So this would help me keep up!
I haven't published a roadmap yet, so this would be really helpful. Might it also be possible to choose layout and colour themes?!

This would be great! At the moment, I'm just upvoting posts in order to save them. But this means my upvoted list is overflowing and is hard to manage. Being able to bookmark posts would be really helpful.
I'd love to see this! It always makes me so happy to see little details like these on websites.

replies.content: While waiting for dark mode, there are browser extensions that will also do the job. Search for 'dark theme' followed by your browser. There might be a need to turn off the extension for sites with naturally black backgrounds though.

Good point! Using any kind of style extension is great and can be highly customizable, like the ability to change contrast and brightness. I'd prefer not to use one of such extensions, however, for security and privacy reasons.
Bumping this. It would be good to have a tab with a feed of people I follow so it's easy to see what they've voted on lately. I learn a lot by reading other people's reasoning.
Me too! I'd also love to see celebrations at specific points as well. It would help people take a moment to celebrate their achievements!
